$comment: Install policy of skill_eval.py install (unit B6, plan.md:1367-1370), read by engine/install.py load_policy. destinations: per unit kind and tool, the project-scope path under --target ({name} is the unit name; a path ending in / is a folder that receives every file of a skill), its source, and verified (a date the source was read, or UNVERIFIED, which every install line prints). user_scope: Claude agents only (Appendix E Q12, plan.md:1779-1782); the loader refuses any other entry. forbidden_roots and forbidden_files are relative to both homes ($HOME and the account home from pwd); the loader refuses a policy that drops any root or file plan.md:1369 names (engine/install.py FLOOR_ROOTS, FLOOR_FILES). tool_pins: the tool versions drift compares against (plan.md:1370); they live here and not in targets/*.json because schemas/targets.schema.json is closed (additionalProperties false) and outside unit B6.
